data.description:
ONE ticket, ONE PR, by operator ruling (2026-08-14): the ≤760px navigation redesign plus every phone-width defect from the mobile QA sweep merge together.

## Binding design
prototypes/mobile-nav/index.html (committed 850ccc58) — drive it. Rulings encoded there:
- ≤760px: the bottom strip is DELETED; nav becomes an overlay drawer off an ink-filled hamburger (primary-action register, 36×30, white 2px lines) top-left in the topbar. 761–1000px icon rail unchanged.
- The drawer is the Sidebar component VERBATIM — CSS repositions it, no second nav implementation. Full parity: brand, conference switcher, group labels, all sidebar rows at 40px touch height, footer.
- Mobile topbar = hamburger + flexing search + avatar, nothing else. Theme select moves into the drawer footer at phone width.
- Dismissal: scrim tap, ✕, Escape, any navigation. aria-modal dialog semantics; focus → ✕ on open, → hamburger on close; page scroll locks; 160ms ease-out, none under prefers-reduced-motion.
- Drawer scrollbar THEMED via tokens (scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--line-strong) transparent + ::-webkit-scrollbar pair) so dark registers inherit. Never OS-default chrome inside themed chrome.

## Defect register (mobile QA, 390px viewport — full detail in ticket comment M-01..M-22)
Root-cause fixes, in commit order for reviewability:
1. M-01 BLOCKER, fix first: .global-search { width:100% } at ≤760 makes header.topbar 549px wide in a 373px viewport → 176px page-level h-scroll on EVERY admin screen, theme+account off-viewport. Fix: flex:1; min-width:0; theme select to drawer foot. (/reviewer has no topbar and scrolls 373/373 — proof.)
2. Drawer fold itself (see design above). The ≤1000px hides of .event-context-row/.nav-label/.sidebar-foot must band to (max-width:1000px) and (min-width:761px), WRITTEN PREFIX-FIRST so MRQ-203 contract tests' indexOf("@media (max-width: 1000px)") still matches. DeliveryHealthShell mounts Sidebar+Topbar too — wire it identically. .page bottom padding returns to normal (no strip to clear).
3. M-04/M-13/M-14 grid blowout family (BLOCKERS on /dashboard + /delivery-health, major /evaluation): outer grid tracks with auto min-content minimums compute literal 734px/635px columns in 341px containers. minmax(0,1fr) on outer tracks + single-column phone breakpoints on inner grids (344px 344px, 366px 366px, 86px 594px).
4. Touch targets app-wide (M-02/03/09/14/15/16/19 + M-11/M-17 controls): 12px checkboxes, 17-20px inputs/selects, 22-26px chips/tabs/buttons, 15px name-buttons. One breakpoint-scoped pass on shared control geometry: ≥24×24 visual, ≥40px hit at ≤760 (WCAG 2.2 AA floor is 24; Apple floor 44).
5. Tables at phone width (M-07 roster, M-10 onboarding matrix, M-11 comms, M-15 files, M-16 people): the field the screen exists for (STATUS etc.) must be visible without sideways scroll — column-priority or card-collapse. /tasks and /reviewer are the clean references.
6. M-08 + M-15/M-16 pagination: roster/onboarding render all ~508 rows (34,900px docs); /submissions' 50-at-a-time pattern already exists — apply it. R7.
7. Polish where cheap: M-05/M-18 scroll affordances, M-10 chip overflow, M-11 message-status 9px overflow, M-17 name-button above move-select spacing, M-21 public /agenda target sizes. M-06 board stays a kanban scroller (its nested-axis pain dies with M-01); single-column board mode explicitly OUT of scope.

## Acceptance
- At 390px: document.scrollWidth == viewport width on EVERY admin route (the M-20 /reviewer standard).
- Drawer full parity + all dismissal paths + focus discipline as prototyped; strip gone.
- /dashboard and /delivery-health fully readable at rest — "Plan next wave", ACT NOW banner + "Open the list" on-screen.
- Roster STATUS / files STATUS visible without horizontal scroll; roster+onboarding paginate.
- Interactive controls meet the target floor at ≤760.
- MRQ-203 contract tests updated only where the ≤760 contract changed; suite within budget; pr-gate green.
- in_validation: drive the real site at 390px (browser pane) across all admin routes + drawer flows; attach evidence.
data.title: Mobile update: drawer nav + phone-width sweep (single PR)

data.body:
# Marquee — Mobile QA (390px phone viewport)

Live site: https://marquee.stage11.dev · signed in via `?demo=organizer`
Viewport: 390 css px wide (373px content width after a 17px classic scrollbar), dpr 2.
Shots: `mobile-qa-shots/`

**Excluded by brief (known/being redesigned):** the ≤760px bottom nav strip itself, and
the conference switcher / sidebar footer being unreachable. Content the nav *covers* is
still reported.

---

## M-01 · App-wide horizontal scroll: the topbar is 549px wide in a 373px viewport — **BLOCKER**

- **Screen:** every admin screen (found on /submissions, confirmed on all others)
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/submissions
- **What's wrong:** `header.topbar` lays out search + theme toggle + theme `<select>` +
  account button in a single non-wrapping row. Its `scrollWidth` is **549px** against a
  `clientWidth` of 373px, and `overflow-x` is `visible`, so it drags the whole document
  into a **176px page-level horizontal scroll**. Consequences:
  1. Every screen scrolls sideways. Content parks against the left edge with a dead grey
     gutter on the right (see `01b`), so any accidental horizontal swipe desyncs the page
     from the fixed bottom nav.
  2. The **theme toggle, theme selector, and the account button ("AC") are off-viewport at
     rest** — invisible until you discover the sideways scroll. Account is the org/role
     surface; on a phone it reads as missing, not as scrolled-away.
- **Severity:** blocker (it is the root cause of the sideways scroll on *every* screen,
  and it hides the account control)
- **Shots:** `mobile-qa-shots/01-submissions.png` (at rest — theme/account absent),
  `mobile-qa-shots/01b-submissions-scrolled-right.png` (scrolled 176px right — controls appear)

## M-02 · Row checkboxes are 12×12px — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Abstracts & sessions (and every table with row selection)
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/submissions
- **What's wrong:** the select-all and per-row checkboxes measure **12×12 css px**. Apple's
  and Google's floors are 44×44 / 48×48; the WCAG 2.2 AA minimum is 24×24. At 12px they are
  roughly a quarter of the minimum target area, stacked ~97px apart vertically in a list you
  are meant to multi-select from. Bulk actions are effectively unusable by thumb.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `mobile-qa-shots/01-submissions.png`

## M-03 · Toolbar controls sit at 22–26px tall across the app — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Abstracts & sessions; the same control set recurs on most admin screens
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/submissions
- **What's wrong:** 61 interactive elements on this one screen fall under a 28px box.
  Saved-view chips ("All submissions", "Drafts needing attention 40", "Decided · not
  notified 610"), "Save current view", "Columns" are all **26px tall**; the ALL /
  ABSTRACTS / SESSIONS segmented control is **22px tall**. These are the primary filter
  affordances on the densest screen in the product.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `mobile-qa-shots/01-submissions.png`

## M-04 · Dashboard cards are 734px wide — half the Program pipeline is off-viewport — **BLOCKER**

- **Screen:** Program pipeline (dashboard)
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/dashboard
- **What's wrong:** `.dashboard-grid` computes to `grid-template-columns: 734px` inside a
  341px container, so **every card is 734px wide** — 2× the viewport. `document.scrollWidth`
  is **750px**. The right half of every card is off-screen at rest and reachable only by
  horizontally scrolling the whole document. Lost content includes:
  - the **"Plan next wave"** button (the card's only action)
  - all three wave progress bars and their `n accepted / n target` numbers — the Wave
    Planner is *only* dates and names without them
  - the right half of the WORK IN MOTION stat grid and the track chips
  - the **"Open onboarding"** button and every **"Due <date>"** chip in the Speaker Task
    Dashboard
- **Severity:** blocker — this is the operator's home screen and half of it is invisible.
- **Shots:** `02-dashboard.png` (at rest), `02b-dashboard-right-column.png` (scrolled 377px right)

## M-05 · Pipeline stage strip truncates its third card and has no scroll affordance — **POLISH**

- **Screen:** Program pipeline · Live strip
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/dashboard
- **What's wrong:** `.dashboard-pipeline` is a 910px horizontal scroller in a 339px box.
  SUBMITTED and IN REVIEW fit; the third stage (WAVED) is sliced mid-word — "Decision w…
  prepared →". Nothing (fade, arrow, peeking edge) says the remaining ~5 stages exist. A
  half-card reads as a rendering bug rather than an invitation to scroll.
- **Severity:** polish
- **Shot:** `02-dashboard.png`

## M-06 · Program board: an 1680px, 8-column board inside a 339px scroller, nested inside a page that also scrolls horizontally — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Program board
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/board
- **What's wrong:** `.program-board-card-shell` scrolls 339 → **1680px**; columns are 210px,
  so the viewport shows 1.6 of 8 stages, the second sliced vertically through its cards.
  Card titles, track chips and the `0h in stage` meta on that half-column are all cut. To
  reach "DECLINED / NOT ADVANCING" you drag ~1340px sideways *inside* a container that is
  itself inside a document with its own 176px horizontal scroll (M-01) — two competing
  horizontal axes under one thumb. There is no stage picker or single-column fallback.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `03-board.png`

## M-07 · Speakers roster: STATUS / SESSIONS / ACTIONS columns are entirely off-screen — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Speakers
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/roster
- **What's wrong:** `.speaker-table-wrap` scrolls 339 → **892px**. At rest you see SPEAKER and
  a clipped TITLE & COMPANY; **STATUS** (Pending / Invited / Confirmed — the field the
  filter chips above are all about), SESSIONS and the row **Open** action are past the right
  edge. Emails truncate at 141px (`aarush.selvan@example…`). The screen's whole job —
  see who is confirmed — cannot be done without sideways scrolling every row.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `05-roster.png`

## M-08 · Roster and Onboarding render every row: 34,900px and 34,547px tall documents — **MAJOR**

- **Screens:** Speakers (/roster), Onboarding (/onboarding)
- **What's wrong:** /roster reports `scrollHeight` **34,900px** for 508 speakers and
  /onboarding **34,547px**; neither paginates or virtualizes at phone width. That is roughly
  55 phone-viewports of continuous scroll with no jump-to-letter, no pagination, and a
  fixed bottom nav eating the bottom of every one of them. /submissions, by contrast,
  renders 50 at a time (3,897px) — the pattern exists, it just isn't applied here.
  Also relevant to R7 (speed is a feature): 509 and 1,021 interactive nodes respectively
  are live in the DOM at once.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shots:** `05-roster.png`, `06-onboarding.png`

## M-09 · Native `<select>` filters render 18px tall — **MAJOR**

- **Screens:** Speakers (/roster), Onboarding (/onboarding)
- **What's wrong:** the TRACK / status `<select>` controls measure **18px high** (190px and
  315px wide). 18px is under half the 44px floor and visibly thinner than the text inputs
  they sit beside, so the row reads as misaligned as well as being hard to hit.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shots:** `05-roster.png`, `06-onboarding.png`

## M-10 · Onboarding matrix: 1088px table, and the TRACK cell clips its own chip — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Onboarding
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/onboarding
- **What's wrong:** `.onboarding-matrix-wrap` scrolls 322 → **1088px**, so INVITE /
  COLLEAGUES / ANNOUNCE and the rest of the milestone columns are off-screen — and this is a
  matrix, i.e. a screen whose entire value is comparing columns across a row. Separately,
  `td.onboarding-track-column` is 138px against a 168px `<span class="onboarding-track">`
  with `overflow` visible: the chip **overflows its own cell** rather than truncating,
  so long track names bleed into the neighbouring column.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `06-onboarding.png`

## M-11 · Communications: message rows clip a 340px sender/subject line into a 49px cell — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Communications
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/communications
- **What's wrong:** 51 clipped text nodes. The worst: a row label whose content is
  `Aarush Selvan · Going deep on Gemini Deep Research` (340px of text) rendered in a **49px**
  box — the recipient's name is cut after ~4 characters, so rows are not distinguishable
  from one another. `Reminder: Initial review has 100 re…` sits in 143px of 370px.
  Separately, `span.message-status` ("held in demo outbox · would send in prod") is 329px
  wide and pushes `.page` to 382px — a 9px page overflow of its own, on top of M-01.
  Row checkboxes are **14×14px**.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `08-communications.png`

## M-12 · Tasks is clean — **no defect**

- **Screen:** Tasks · https://marquee.stage11.dev/tasks
- Nothing overflows past the topbar's own 549px, no nested horizontal scrollers, no clipped
  text, 2,200px document. Its 26px buttons ("Edit", "Delete", "Assign to speakers") are the
  only issue and they are the app-wide M-03 pattern. Worth reading as the reference layout.

## M-13 · Speaker follow-ups is the worst instance of the 734px-card bug — **BLOCKER**

- **Screen:** Speaker follow-ups (Delivery health)
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/delivery-health
- **What's wrong:** same root cause as M-04 — `.health-page` resolves to a single
  **734px** grid column in a 341px container, document `scrollWidth` 750px. Here it costs
  the screen its headline: the ACT NOW banner reads **"612 speakers have not heard fro"**,
  cut mid-word, and its body sentence and the "Open the list" action are both off-screen.
  TODAY'S SEND ALLOWANCE loses the right half of its two-column figure grid
  (`.health-quota-figures` = `344px 344px`) and the whole quota bar; the OWED A MESSAGE
  table loses WHAT HAPPENS NEXT mid-word ("The decisio"). 150 clipped text nodes.
- **Diagnosis:** the blowout is a grid track with an `auto` (min-content) minimum —
  `.dashboard-grid` and `.health-page` both compute to a literal `grid-template-columns:
  734px` while their container is 341px — compounded by inner grids that never collapse
  to one column at phone width (`344px 344px`, `366px 366px`, `86px 594px`).
  `minmax(0, 1fr)` on the outer track plus a single-column breakpoint on the inner ones
  is the shape of the fix.
- **Severity:** blocker
- **Shot:** `10-delivery-health.png`

## M-14 · Evaluation has the same blowout at 635px — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Evaluation · https://marquee.stage11.dev/evaluation
- **What's wrong:** `.evaluation-layout` is 635px in a 341px container, document
  `scrollWidth` 651px. The PLAN, EVALUATION SUMMARY and PROGRAM COMMITTEE cards each lose
  their right ~45%. The "Round 1 anonymized" checkbox is **12×12px** and the round-mode
  `<select>` is **18px** tall.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `12-evaluation.png`

## M-15 · Files table is a 969px scroller; STATUS / UPLOADED / VERSION off-screen — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Files · https://marquee.stage11.dev/files
- **What's wrong:** `.files-table-wrap` scrolls 339 → **969px** (FILE · SPEAKER · SESSION ·
  STATUS · UPLOADED · VERSION…). Deliverable **status** — the reason to open this screen — is
  past the right edge. Select-all and per-row checkboxes are **12×12px**, the track
  `<select>` is 18px, and the document is 13,813px tall with no pagination.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `09-files.png`

## M-16 · People CRM stacks two horizontal scrollers, the table 1118px wide — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** People · https://marquee.stage11.dev/people
- **What's wrong:** `.people-instrument` scrolls 339 → 820px and `.people-table-wrap`
  339 → **1118px** (NAME · EMAIL · COMPANY · JOB TITLE · OUTREACH · TAGS…), so the screen
  has two independent sideways axes stacked vertically plus the document's own (M-01).
  Everything past NAME is off-screen. The search `<input>` is **17px** tall.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `14-people.png`

## M-17 · Outreach pipeline: 1145px board, and its card names are 15px-tall buttons — **MAJOR**

- **Screen:** Outreach · https://marquee.stage11.dev/pipeline
- **What's wrong:** `.people-board` scrolls 339 → **1145px** across 190px columns, so
  DECLINED / LOST are ~800px off to the right. The card's primary control — the person's
  name — is a **15px-tall** button (`Grace Isford`, `Margarethe von Habsburg-Lo…`, itself
  clipped from 232px into 152px), sitting directly above a 24px `<select>` that moves the
  person to another conference. A 15px target stacked 9px from a destructive-ish select is
  a mis-tap waiting to happen.
- **Severity:** major
- **Shot:** `15-pipeline.png`

## M-18 · Org settings tabs scroll sideways with no affordance — **POLISH**

- **Screen:** Organization · https://marquee.stage11.dev/org
- **What's wrong:** `.org-tabs` scrolls 324 → 540px; "API tokens" and anything after it sit
  off the right edge of a tab strip that gives no sign it continues. Each tab is **22px** tall.
- **Severity:** polish
- **Shot:** `17-org.png`

## M-19 · Settings: 20px selects and 27px-wide reorder arrows — **POLISH**

- **Screen:** Conference settings · https://marquee.stage11.dev/settings
- **What's wrong:** layout holds up (no page overflow beyond M-01, 5,543px document), but the
  format `<select>` is **20px** tall and the ↑ / ↓ reorder buttons are **27×26px** and sit
  adjacent to each other — the smallest paired targets in the app, on a control whose whole
  job is repeated tapping. `span.settings-social-name` also overflows its 44px box by 10px.
- **Severity:** polish
- **Shot:** `18-settings.png`

## M-20 · Reviewer console is clean — **no defect**

- **Screen:** Reviewer · https://marquee.stage11.dev/reviewer
- `document.scrollWidth` is **373px** — the only admin route with *no* horizontal scroll at
  all, because it renders in its own shell without the `header.topbar` of M-01. Single
  clipped element: `.chip.reviewer-whoami` ("Reviewing as AIE Program Committee") at 168px
  of 224px. Along with /tasks, the reference for what the rest should look like.

## M-21 · Public conference site (/agenda) is clean on layout, small on targets — **POLISH**

- **Screen:** Conference site agenda · https://marquee.stage11.dev/agenda
- **What's wrong:** no horizontal scroll (`scrollWidth` 373), nothing clipped — the public
  surface is the best-behaved page in the build. But it has 63 sub-28px targets in a
  10,239px document: speaker links are **15px** tall (`Grace Isford`, `Hamel Husain`) and the
  "Show more" disclosure is **14px**. These are the two things an attendee actually taps.
- **Severity:** polish
- **Shot:** `19-agenda.png`

## M-22 · Speaker portal empty state is handled well — **no defect**

- **Screen:** Speaker portal · https://marquee.stage11.dev/portal (as an organizer with no
  speaker record)
- No overflow, no clipping. The empty state explains itself ("Nothing here failed: this
  account is not a speaker…") and offers three exits — Speakers, Program home, Return to
  conference. No dead end. Header wraps to two lines at 390px but reads fine.

## M-23 · Submission record: one 2-column meta grid blows out the whole page to 524px — **BLOCKER**

- **Screen:** Submission record
- **URL:** https://marquee.stage11.dev/submissions/91a59ed5-5eaf-4fd4-81a9-0d5a5d17ae3e
- **What's wrong:** every card on the record is **524px wide in a 341px column**, so the
  right ~35% of the page is off-viewport and *every line of body copy is cut*. The abstract,
  the decision-history note, "Saved changes are recorded i…", the SESSION CONTENT
  sub-heading, the title `<input>` and the abstract `<textarea>` all lose their right edge.
  The text is not failing to wrap — it is wrapping correctly **to a 490px measure and then
  being clipped at 373px**, which is why it reads as sliced rather than as reflowed.
- **Exact cause — a single element:** `.record-meta-grid` computes to
  `grid-template-columns: 239.98px 240px`. It is a two-column grid with a **~240px minimum
  per track** that never collapses (a `repeat(2, minmax(240px, 1fr))`-shaped rule, not an
  `auto-fit` one), so it demands 490px in a container that has 341px. Its second column runs
  283 → 523px against a 373px viewport: **SUBMITTED, WAVE and PUBLIC STATUS are entirely
  off-screen.** That 490px then propagates straight up the tree, widening everything above it:

  `.record-meta-grid` 490 → `.record-summary` 490 → `.card-body` 522 → `section.card` 524 →
  `.record-main.stack` (single track computes to **523.98px**) → `.record-layout` (`clientWidth`
  341, `scrollWidth` 524)

  `.record-layout` itself is correct — a single 341px track. The break is entirely below it.
- **Fix shape:** collapse `.record-meta-grid` to one column at phone width — e.g.
  `repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 240px), 1fr))` — and give `.record-main.stack` a
  `minmax(0, 1fr)` track so a too-wide descendant can never widen its ancestors again. The
  second change is the one that generalises: it is the same auto-minimum propagation behind
  M-04 (`.dashboard-grid` → 734px), M-13 (`.health-page` → 734px) and M-14
  (`.evaluation-layout` → 635px).
- **Severity:** blocker
- **Shot:** `21-submission-record.png`

BUILD NOTE (orchestrator): M-23 names the general mechanism for the whole grid-blowout family — intrinsic (auto/min-content) track minimums propagating up through grid ancestors. Fix pattern, apply everywhere it recurs: minmax(0,1fr) on ancestor stack/layout tracks (record-main.stack, dashboard-grid, health-page, evaluation-layout) + collapse fixed-minimum inner grids at phone width (record-meta-grid, health-quota-figures, and the 344/366/86-594 pairs). This is commit-order item 3 of the ticket description; the record page joins that family.
